chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Al-Husayn ibn Atiyya, from Zayd al-Sa'igh, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Supplicate to Allah for us.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'O Allah! Grant them truthful narration, and fulfillment of the trust, and preservation upon the prayers. O Allah! They are the most deserving of Your creatures that You do this for them. O Allah, and do it for them.'

key_terms.أَدَاءَ الْأَمَانَةِ: Fulfillment of the trust / Delivering what is entrusted
key_terms.صِدْقَ الْحَدِيثِ: Truthful narration / Speaking truth in transmitting hadith

ai.seo_question: What are the key virtues requested in the supplication of Imam al-Sadiq for his followers?
ai.summary: This concise supplication highlights the triad of epistemic integrity, moral responsibility, and ritual devotion as the foundation of a believer's character. In Shia scholarly tradition, 'truthful narration' (sidq al-hadith) is not merely about accuracy in transmitting reports but signifies a holistic truthfulness in speech and action, while 'fulfillment of the trust' (ada' al-amanah) encompasses all divine and social obligations. The Imam’s emphasis on steadfastness in prayers underscores their role as the practical anchor for maintaining these higher spiritual states.
